Jen: Quick non-work poll — if you could rename exactly one weekday, which would you pick and what would you call it? Keep it silly. :grin:
Alex: Wednesday -> 'Middlemarch' because I suddenly feel like literary drama.
Omar: Friday -> 'Friyay' (oldie but goldie) :tada:
Cass: Tuesday -> 'Choose-day' — makes meetings sound purposeful.
Leah: Monday -> 'Mooday' — honestly accurate :coffee:
Alex: Also considering 'Moonday' for lunar energy :full_moon_with_face:
Omar: I cast my vote for 'Choose-day'. @Jen, can we get a sticker of that? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Jen: Alright, do the classic — react with 1️⃣ for Alex, 2️⃣ for Omar, 3️⃣ for Cass, 4️⃣ for Leah.
BotKudos: poll created — reactions unlocked (auto)
Cass: Tie-breaker suggestion: whoever brings the best treat to the next retro wins the naming rights. :thinking_face:
Leah: Treats are a solid tiebreaker. I volunteer to judge. :cake:
Alex: Challenge accepted. Gluten-free cinnamon buns incoming. :yum:
Omar: If Alex bakes, I'll pledge allegiance to whatever weekday he calls for. Deal? :handshake:
Jen: Deal. Results in 24h. Winner gets immortalization in #random and a tiny virtual badge. :medal:
